scope: Genuine current pre-ammunition state from an unchanged Cuyo suffix executed on the older earned funded507 Yatasto input. Not a direct capture of the failed complete4e historical-loss run or a fresh-prefix/ending pass.
producer: assembleCreatedCuyo then prepareCreatedMendozaAssault, with only passive reporting before the unchanged conservation assertion
normalization: none; exact official save envelope admitted from the passive beforeCampaign

physicalOwnershipModel.servingOperatives: Current living noncaptured recruited operative records own carried ammunition. Positive-HP player scene copies with a global operative record are old visit history, including expired hires and old living copies of now-dead people. Real dead scene bodies still own their remaining rounds.
physicalOwnershipModel.missionAllies: A living retained missionAllies record owns its actual gear unless the same person is currently serving. Its positive-HP scene copy is only a mirror. Scene-only allied units without a retained/global owner remain physical owners.
physicalOwnershipModel.garrisons: Living c.garrisons units own their actual gear once; matching positive-HP player scene copies are mirrors. A dead militia body remains a scene owner after returnGarrison removes its retained living record. A scene-only player without a global or retained owner remains counted.
sourceReferences: game/campaign.js:commitDeploymentReturn applies returned health/gear to current operative records; a later request reissues current deploymentOperative values
game/world.js:enterSector creates current squad/garrison/mission-allies units and retains military bodies, not old absent living player copies
game/garrison.js:prepareGarrison and returnGarrison retain actual militia identity, gear and surviving records
campaigns/granaderos/missions.js:sanLorenzoAlly reads the retained missionAllies.san_lorenzo record before any template
physicalOwnershipModel.controlScope: Garrison and scene-only controls use actual prepareGarrison/createBattle/returnGarrison data contracts; they are ownership-model/loss controls, not fabricated campaign victory, injury, funding or acceptance.

retainedMissionAllyOwner.acceptedUse: The same retained ally is read by the current stock San Lorenzo/Yatasto mission path; the two real charges remain counted, never discarded with the scene copy.

independentLossControls: A copied actual service-return-2-5 stack loses one pistol round and must change the strict vector by exactly one.
A copied actual service-return-2-0 loaded musket loses one charge and must change the strict vector by exactly one.
The actual retained missionAllies.san_lorenzo 57 loses one pistol charge and must change the vector, despite the unchanged scene mirror.
The actual dead player body110 in San Lorenzo loses one loaded musket charge and must change the vector, despite its dead global record.
An actual garrison issue/return-model retained unit loses one loaded charge and must change the vector despite an unchanged living scene mirror.
A scene-only player with no global or retained owner, and a dead militia body after returnGarrison, must retain their sole physical rounds and expose a one-charge loss.
